## Context / Problem
Five approved prose upgrades to the implement-side skill and the shared test-design doc, targeting the largest escape classes: parity siblings at build time, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings fixed without oracle upgrades, and known gaps evaporating at close. (Bug-trend review changes 18-22; enforcement twins deliberately not proposed where FP modes dominate.)

## Approach
All prose, no new gate machinery:
(18) SKILL.md 4a surface-parity census, defined self-contained here (no equivalent exists yet in rebar-debug to inherit; sibling ticket 78f1 adds the debug-side analog independently): when the change touches one of several parallel surfaces, enumerate five slots — CLI / MCP-API / library-facade / automated-callers / dual-direction (reconcile read+write) — each slot dispositioned in-scope-and-proven-through-that-surface or out-of-scope-with-reason (feeds the Phase-5 sweep).
(19) test-design.md §6 config-effect contrast: for each config key the change reads or should read, one test proving the key CHANGES BEHAVIOR through the real read path (default vs non-default contrast), not merely that a value is parsed — targets the read-but-miswired class (9d7a: honored by MCP server, ignored by comment tool).
(20-prose) SKILL.md contention triggers, narrowed to op-level semantics (case c): if the change (i) composes >=2 locked operations or check-then-act across store reads/writes, (ii) adds its own retry/backoff/reclamation logic, or (iii) introduces a cache/snapshot over store state — add contention cases to the EXISTING shared suites by shape: composed/check-then-act writes -> tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py (two_clones fixture); write-storm/retry-reclamation -> tests/integration/test_store_concurrency.py (storm suite); read-integrity-under-contention (shape iii, the ed2b class) -> tests/interfaces/store/test_reads_under_sync_contention.py via the shared tests/interfaces/store/sync_contention_harness.py. 'Never a bespoke harness' means reuse these shared fixtures/harnesses — it does not claim no read-contention harness exists. Changes riding existing seams (single locked op) are exempt.
(21) SKILL.md 4g gate-finding oracle upgrade: a behavioral gate finding gets a RED test FIRST in the same amended change, then the fix; non-behavioral (naming/docs/style) fixed directly — exemption stated to prevent change-detector tests.
(22) Phase 5 + Reporting residual-gap disposition sweep over an enumerable source checklist (4a census out-of-scope slots, 4b exclusions, 4e-bis compromises, deferred 4g advisories): each item filed (ticket + discovered_from) / accepted-with-reason / fixed; 'none' legitimate.

## Scope
- examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md (4a, contention trigger block, 4g, Phase 5, Reporting)
- examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md §6 (+ sync of per-skill copies enforced by tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py)

## Testing
Prose-only: skill sync test must stay green (test_skill_shared_sync.py); dry-run read-through of the census + contention triggers against two historical bugs (9d7a config-miswire; ed2b pagination-under-writes).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] All five prose blocks landed at the named anchors; no new gate machinery introduced.
- [x] Contention trigger text scopes to the three case-c shapes and routes each shape to its existing shared suite by path (two_clones / storm / reads-under-sync-contention harness).
- [x] Shared test-design.md copies in sync (test green).
- [x] Census slots and disposition checklist use forced-artifact wording (in-scope-proven / out-of-scope-reason / filed / accepted / fixed).
